meta.title: Flagged for Review — every unverified value, assumption and irregularity (non-blocking)
meta.rule: These items are published for review. They block nothing, but none of them may be treated as verified until resolved. Each links to the best official source available.

flags.detail: Literature constant used for Pythag metrics; NOT an official NFL value. Affects pythag/luck_delta columns only.

flags.detail: Historical NFL margin standard deviation (literature); used for P(home) and fair moneylines. UNVERIFIED vs official source.

flags.detail: Derived from model v1 via F-02; no market comparison possible (G7 blocked); informational only, NOT executable prices.

flags.detail: r(net_ppg,pct)=+0.876 etc. describe this season only; not predictive validation; BH-FDR applied across the 6 tests.
